cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before we sell this bottled cloud, measure from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the new assistant. I can only find two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Naturally. The third appears when addressed by its professional title. Say 'Professor.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Those are its credentials. Count the drops; that gives us its sleeve size.
